    The radical quotient used in BGRS Figure 13 #

    If both halves of Roiter's square alternative fail, the preceding parameter reduction supplies one middle radical generator tau with both f tau^2 and tau^2 g nonzero. BGRS Section 4.1 quotients by the two-sided ideal generated by those two elements and realizes Figure 13D by sending its two central occurrences, and its two vertical arrows, to the same quotient object and the same image of tau.

    This file formalizes that quotient and the exact representation-finiteness obstruction. It also proves that the two paths adjacent to the killed relations and the middle tau^2 path survive the full two-generator ideal. In the hard transit/cotransit branch, nonexceptionality of the outer composite f g makes the fourth path survive as well. Thus the remaining source boundary is the finite supplement calculation showing that nonexceptionality supplies both strict-span families and hence a forbidden cleavage.
